title: Fix NATS poison pill handling — don't ACK unparseable messages
description:
**Bug**: `core/infra/bus/nats.go:148-168` — When a message fails to unmarshal (poison pill), it's ACKed and lost forever. Should either NAK with delay, send to DLQ, or log and term-ACK.

**Fix**: Distinguish unmarshal errors from handler errors. Unmarshal failures should go to DLQ or be NAKed with bounded retries.

**Files**: `core/infra/bus/nats.go`
definitionOfDone: Unparseable messages are not silently ACKed
Poison pills either go to DLQ or are NAKed with max retries

implementationPlan.description:
Also add error logging for the ACK/NAK calls that currently use `_ =`:
```go
if err := msg.Ack(); err != nil {
    log.Printf("nats bus: ack failed: %v", err)
}
```
Apply to all 3 ACK calls (lines 152, 165, 168) and the NAK calls (lines 158, 160).
Run `go test ./core/infra/bus/...` to verify no regressions.
